snippet.title: Ash & Adam's Existential Treads - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Existential Treads is a retro-flavored top down shooter mashed together with a settlement builder mashed together with a tower defense game.  It's the post post apocalypse and you need to help humanity come back from the ashes.  Rescue people from the wastes and build new settlements together.  But be careful; you need to defend them against the rogue AI that destroyed the world the first time. 

Pick it up on Steam or Itch.io.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3580340/Ash__Adams_Existential_Treads/ 
https://ashadamsgames.itch.io/existential-treads

#indiegame #indiegamedev #steamgame #towerdefense #actionrts
